# Terminal2K

Terminal2K is a retro terminal aesthetic with crisp white text on a deep black background and electric green accents for bold, italic and inline code. Its layout is minimal and high-contrast, aimed at focused writing and extended readability.

![Terminal2K screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/isax785/Terminal2K/HEAD/img/screenshot.png)

